system.description: Creates an invisible magical barrier that discourages approach. Acts as a mental deterrent: a creature needs Dodge MDV at least equal to successes on the roll to ignore the unnatural mental influence. A creature may spend 1 Willpower per scene to ignore the ward (may incur Limit). Lasts one day. Protects (Degree × 20) feet in any direction. If limited to a specific subtype, grants +1 die per Degree (does not count as specialty).
